title: Auto-generate recording notes in the background via an App-level hook
context: Recording detail gained AI features (notes with auto-title, auto-summarize and .md export; timestamped transcript; chat over the meeting). The commit message does not state why notes should generate without a user action.
decision: Recording detail is split into Notes | Transcript | Ask sub-tabs. Notes are generated automatically: App.js calls useAutoSummarize(recordingsData) and passes the result to Recordings as `auto`, so recordings that finish transcribing while the app is open get notes in the background. The CSS comment describes these pieces as on-device AI.
consequences: Background summarization is tied to the app being open. The hook's comment limits it to recordings that finish transcribing while the app is open.
Notes, transcript and chat share one recording detail view, with a new RecordingNotes, RecordingTranscript and RecordingAsk component each.
Transcript segments support click-to-seek, translation and editing.
Recordings, RecordingDetail and load changed; useRecordings and aiNotes.js are also touched.
